strategy_sections.name: MAGIC_FORMULA
strategy_sections.coverage: Five-stock sample; all five pass $10M and 300K SMA20 share-volume gates; EV and TTM ROIC unverified. No combined rank.

strategy_sections.name: PARABOLIC_MOMENTUM
strategy_sections.coverage: Five selected unusually active common stocks, not market-wide; 10 completed daily candles each, 61 bars of inputs per symbol. Exact platform group/indicator semantics not verified.

native_variant.method: Common anchor in last 10 completed daily candles; upper SMA20+2 population SD including anchor; RVOL=anchor volume/mean preceding 20; ROC=100*(C/C[-5]-1). No entry/exit approval.
native_variant.source: Robinhood MCP get_equity_historicals (regular daily split-adjusted; 61 bars 2026-09-01 through 2026-11-25)
native_variant.signal: INSM native mechanical pass; WATCH ONLY, exact version UNVERIFIED, no order.

strategy_sections.name: RSI_OVERSOLD
strategy_sections.coverage: Wilder daily RSI14 seeded with 14 differences, 61 daily bars; weekly unavailable; threshold <=30. AMBA 25.88 and NTNX 22.93 are sample reversal-watch observations only; no reversal confirmation.

strategy_sections.name: 52_WEEK_HIGHS
strategy_sections.coverage: Five sampled stocks below provider 52-week high; SwingTradeBot reports 75 qualifying closing highs and 15 lows under its own universe, not Legion ranking. No verified top 10.

strategy_sections.name: OTHER_INTELLIGENCE
strategy_sections.coverage: Long-base breakout, compounder and replacement ranking, proprietary LuxAlgo, ATH VWAP, long MAs, squeeze, short interest, insider activity, portfolio review and full relative-strength board not verified; no recommendation.
